name: take_append_drop
prelude:
def myTake : Nat → List α → List α
  | 0, _ => []
  | _ + 1, [] => []
  | n + 1, x :: xs => x :: myTake n xs

def myDrop : Nat → List α → List α
  | 0, xs => xs
  | _ + 1, [] => []
  | n + 1, _ :: xs => myDrop n xs
statement: theorem take_append_drop (n : Nat) (xs : List α) : myTake n xs ++ myDrop n xs = xs
proofs:
induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => cases xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs => simp [myTake, myDrop, ih]
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil => cases n <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih => cases n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => simp [myTake, myDrop, ih]
strategies: Induction on n with the list generalized.
Induction on xs with the count generalized.
